# SaaSSuite

> The all-in-one white-label toolkit for HighLevel (GoHighLevel) agencies running SaaS mode.

SaaSSuite gives HighLevel agencies branded onboarding, native AI support, retention automations, and full white-label customization on top of HighLevel SaaS mode. It's purpose-built for agencies who resell HighLevel to their own clients.

## Pages
- [Home](/): What SaaSSuite is and who it's for.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Monthly and yearly plans for SaaS-mode agencies plus per-account Agency Support plans.
- [Webinar](/webinar): Live product walkthrough for HighLevel agency owners.
- [Blog](/blog): Playbooks and guides for running a HighLevel white-label SaaS.

## Products
- [Onboarding](/onboardings): Interactive walkthroughs, video onboarding, and checklists.
- [AI support](/support): Native AI chat trained on your knowledge base with human handover.
- [Branding tool](/branding-tool): Full white-label CSS, colors, fonts, and login customization.
- [Login tracking](/login-tracking): Behavioral tracking for HighLevel SaaS retention.
- [Email warmup](/email-warmup): Domain and inbox warmup for HighLevel-based email sends.
- [Affiliate program](/affiliate): Earn recurring revenue for HighLevel agency referrals.
